days.description: 读取最近 N 天日志,缺省 7,上限 30。

tools.name: memory_expand
tools.description: 白板结构化展开(P3, 需 boardMode=graph):正向遍历——给定 tag(如 type:dead-end / topic:登录)展开所有匹配的账本/白板条目 Content,默认 limit 10、硬帽 20。返回条目 id、标题、来源(source 文件+行)与判据状态。适合主动重建上下文(如「把所有失败方案列出来」)。

tag.description: 要展开的 tag,如 type:dead-end 或 topic:主题名。

limit.description: 返回条数上限,缺省 10,硬帽 20。

tools.name: memory_external
tools.description: 查看/接入其他 AI 工具(AI 助手/CodeBuddy/Claude Code/Codex/ZCode/Kimi Code/TRAE/项目约定文件)的记忆。action=list 列出全部检测到的外部记忆源(路径/大小/预览/会话数);action=import **以纯链接模式**接入(source 为源 id,target=project 接进项目笔记 / user 接进用户级记忆)。★**「纯链接模式」的含义**:只在你的记忆里写一条**源文件绝对路径指针**,**不把对方内容抄进来**——目的是①防外部脏内容混入、②对方内容会变而指针不会过期。⇒ 需要内容时**按指针路径读取原文件**或记忆里说明的路径,不要去猜。★首次在新工作区工作时先 list,判断该项目是否曾在其他 AI 工具里做过。首次在新工作区工作、或用户提到其他软件里做过的事时调用。

action.description: list=列出外部记忆源; import=接入指定源。

source.description: 要接入的源 id(action=import 时必填,来自 list 结果)。

target.description: 接入目标: project=项目笔记(默认), user=用户级记忆。

tools.name: memory_log
tools.description: 向当前工作区的 .dsh-memory/ 今日日志追加一条工作记录(append-only,自动建目录/文件)。完成实质性工作(改代码/修 bug/写文档/重构/技术选型/用户偏好约定)后必须调用;有跨会话长期价值的内容在同一轮内一并写入记忆(memory_note 项目/ memory_user 跨项目),progress 与 memory 一起写;不要记录临时信息。**★顺手维护白板(G4/M3,2026-09-17)**:若本次工作让**白板或账本所述与现状不符**(方向变了/阶段完成/旧结论被推翻),请在同一次回复里顺带调用 `memory_note`:项目稳定事实变了用 `kind=plan` 重写白板(旧版自动归档),动态状态变了用 `kind=handoff` 新开一篇账本(append-only,不追改旧账本)。**这是条件触发,不是每回都做**;白板功能关闭时跳过即可,不要因此报错。**调用后必须在本轮回复正文(摘要可见的正文,不是工具调用区)中向用户转述一句:如"已把 X 记入今日日志"**。

note.description: 简短条目:一句话概括做了什么、结果如何。

date.description: 日志日期 YYYY-MM-DD,**缺省今天**。★可补写过去某天(如补记昨天的工作)——会写进那一天的文件,不会覆盖同文件已有内容(append-only)。格式非法时静默回退到今天。

kind.description: ★P6B:条目性质标记(缺省 fact)。rule=用户规则/约定;preference=偏好;todo=待办;fact=事实记录。是规则或用户明确约定的条目请传 kind=rule——它会被规则层识别为必须遵守的约束。纯标记、零额外 LLM 调用。

tools.name: memory_maintain
tools.description: 维护记忆(30 天蒸馏):把 days(缺省30)天前的 .dsh-memory/ 每日日志交给 AI 蒸馏提炼出有长期价值的要点写入项目 MEMORY.md,原文保底归档到 .dsh-memory/archive/ 后从活跃日志移除。AI 不可用时降级为原样归档,不丢信息。★**归档语义(2026-10-13)**:归档 = 冷存储,原文退出常规检索面(**不进 memory_recall 的 all**),只有蒸馏要点经项目笔记继续参与唤回;**不再把全文回灌项目笔记**(那是注入面,回灌会撑大窗口)。取回归档原文:**列目录** memory_read(kind="archive")、**按键找** memory_recall(scope="archive", query="…")、**取全文** memory_read(kind="archive", name="…")。任何情况下都不删归档副本。

days.description: **归档阈值天数**,缺省 30。语义:把**早于「今天 − days 天」**的每日日志挑出来蒸馏,不是「最近 days 天」。**只影响活跃日志的可见性,不删信息**——要点进 MEMORY.md,原文整份归档到 `.dsh-memory/archive/`。AI 不可用时降级为原样归档。★属**低频维护动作**,不要每轮调。

tools.name: memory_note
tools.description: 更新当前项目长期笔记 .dsh-memory/MEMORY.md(本项目专属的约定、决策、架构要点),或写交接白板。kind=note(默认):action=append 追加一段(自动带日期标题)/action=replace 整体替换(需先基于注入内容或 memory_recall 结果给出完整新内容),本项目笔记有**容量上限**(字符,设置项 noteCapacityChars,默认 24000);**超出时的行为**(你不需要自己控制长度,写就是):①先把较早内容交给 AI 折叠成要点(同一层 10 分钟内只整理一次);②整理失败则**整条原文**归档到 `.dsh-memory/archive/`(信息不丢);③整理后仍超才拒绝(正常不会发生)。kind=handoff:写一篇四段式交接账本(任务状态/目标/已试方案与失败原因/进度与下一步)到 handoff/,阶段产出或方向变化时用,给下一个上下文窗口续命;**账本/白板内容要落进面板看板泳道,须在标题或正文写 tag**:type:goal / type:state / type:dead-end / type:progress。kind=plan:先 memory_read(kind=plan) 获取版本再写入共享白板 PLAN.md(人能读的项目全貌规划图)。**首建亦可**——工作区若还没有白板,宿主已自动落了一版骨架,你理解全貌后直接整体重写成真内容即可;对项目全貌的理解发生实质变化时同样重写。旧版自动归档。**别把骨架留在那里当白板**。★白板判据 P-H1(硬性):重写后的 PLAN 必须含**至少 1 个 `## ` 顶层节、且该节正文 ≥20 个非空白字符**——只写标题+引言(没有任何成段的 ## 节)会被判据门拒绝。**结论失效时的两个通道(不要混用)**:supersedes=被更新结论取代(有后继);retract=**当时就做错了、直接撤回**(无后继,本身即教训)。**调用后必须在本轮回复正文中向用户转述:更新了什么**。

content.description: 笔记内容。kind=plan 整篇替换给完整新全貌并带 expectedRevision；单卡更新给完整卡片并带 cardId/expectedCardRevision。

action.description: 仅 kind=note 时有效:append=追加, replace=整体替换。

kind.description: note=项目笔记(默认), handoff=四段式交接账本(新篇), plan=白板全貌重写。 ★plan 重写前必须先 read 磁盘 handoff/PLAN.md 的**原文**并逐条抄回全部 <!--memory:mem_*--> 锚点：注入快照会被截断(显示「…(截断,全文见 handoff/ 白板与账本)」)，不足以据此重写；缺锚点会被保护门拒绝(它会逐条比对前后卡片集合)。每张卡的原文与其用户备注区必须原样带回。

expectedRevision.description: plan 整篇重写必填：memory_read(kind=plan) 返回的 revision。过时版本返回冲突保存路径，不覆盖。

cardId.description: plan 可选条目更新：content 仅提供这一张完整卡（含原锚点），其余卡片保持原文。

expectedCardRevision.description: cardId 更新必填：memory_read(kind=plan) cards 中该卡片 revision。

supersedes.description: （可选）要标为 superseded 的旧条目 memoryId 列表（mem_<32hex>）。**仅在你明确知道被取代的是哪条时传**；不确定就不要传。会在旧条目正文末尾追加一行 `<!-- dsh-status: superseded by=<新条目id> -->`。

retract.description: （可选）要标为 **retracted（撤回）** 的旧条目 memoryId 列表（mem_<32hex>）。**与 supersedes 的分工**：supersedes = 被**更新的结论取代**（有后继结论，可追 mem_id）；**retract = 当时就做错了、直接撤回**（无后继，"错误本身"就是教训）。用户裁定「retracted 不是垃圾，是教训，不过滤只备注」⇒ 检索仍会返回它并标 ⚠已撤回。**强烈建议同时传 retractReason 说明错在哪**。仅在你确知标错的是哪条时传。

retractReason.description: （可选，配合 retract）撤回原因，一行内说明**错在哪**，上限 120 字符。会写成 `reason="…"` 附在状态行上，供检索时显示。

restore.description: （可选）**撤销通道**：把指定 memoryId 的状态改回 current（移除状态行）。用于纠正标错的 superseded/retracted。

archivedIds.description: （可选，仅 kind=plan 有意义）要**显式归档**的卡片 id 列表（mem_<32hex>）。用于白板重写时有意移除某张卡：列进来即视为"合法消失（有留痕）"，不会被丢卡检查拦下。**只在你确实要移除该卡时传**；顺手漏抄卡片不要用它掩盖——那属于内容丢失，应改回原样带回。

tools.name: memory_procedure
tools.description: 把一个**值得复用的流程**写进 procedure memory（技能库）——这是模型直写通路，取代此前的机械生成。什么时候用：你刚跑通了一个多步骤流程、踩坑后总结出了正确做法、或发现某个操作值得下次照做时。**判据**：有明确步骤、可重复、下次遇到类似场景能直接照做。**已有条目要改就用 action=update（传 procedureId），不要另写一条同名新条目**；action=write 进审批列表（保守，推荐先这样）；action=activate 一步到位激活并可被自动召回（仅当你确信它稳定可复用）。写出的条目须含 title + steps，建议一并给 successCriteria（**没有 successCriteria 的条目永远无法晋升**）。

action.description: write=写入并进审批列表（默认）；activate=写入后直接晋升并激活（可被召回，同时自动导出 SKILL.md）。

procedureId.description: 仅 action=update 时需要：要修订的条目 id（完整或前 20 位短码）。

title.description: 一句话说清这是什么流程（如「发布前跑全量回归并核对 SHA256」）。不要用运行时样板文字或纯提问句。**action=write/activate 必填**（缺则明确拒绝）；**action=update 可省略**（要改标题才传）。

steps.description: 流程步骤，**一行一步**（换行分隔）；行首的 "1. " / "- " 会自动去掉。**action=write/activate 必填**（缺则明确拒绝）。

successCriteria.description: 怎么算跑通，一行一条。**强烈建议填写**——缺它则该条目结构上无法晋升。

preconditions.description: 前置条件，一行一条（可选）。

checks.description: 过程中要检查的点，一行一条（可选）。

rollback.description: 失败时怎么回滚，一行一条（可选）。

riskLevel.description: 风险等级，缺省 low。high 会要求人工批准后才可激活。

tools.name: memory_procedure_list
tools.description: 只读浏览技能库(procedure memory)：列出两库里已有哪些流程条目，含**它属于哪个库**（工作区库 / 通用库）、阶段、证据量与「为什么还不能晋升」的原因码。用于**动手写之前先查重**：你要写的流程是否已经存在？是补修它还是新建？也可用 query 做关键词粗筛。**本工具纯只读，不写盘、不晋升、不改任何条目。**

scope.description: 只看哪个库：workspace=工作区库 / global=通用库 / all=两库都看（默认）。

query.description: 关键词粗筛（匹配标题/步骤/完成标准，不区分大小写；可选）。

limit.description: 最多返回条数，缺省 30，硬帽 100。

includeNoise.description: ★#453：是否包含「低质量观察行」（纯 episode 观察行 / 缺 successCriteria 的候选）。缺省 false = 折叠并在末尾提示条数；传 true 才全部列出。

tools.name: memory_read
tools.description: 按需读取记忆文件完整内容(某日日志/反思全文、用户级记忆、项目笔记、日历、**已归档旧日志**),注入上下文只含精简摘要,需要细节时用本工具,不要要求用户粘贴。★**kind=archive 是取回 30 天前归档原文的入口**——归档后原文退出常规检索面(冷存储分层),需显式取;可用 memory_recall(scope="archive") 先找文件名。

kind.description: 读取类型: log=某日日志, reflection=某日反思, user=用户级记忆, notes=项目笔记, calendar=日历, plan=白板, **archive=已归档的旧日志(30 天前的日志原文,冷存储,不在常规检索面,需显式取)**。

name.description: 仅 kind=archive:归档文件名(如 2026-01-01.md)。**缺省=列出全部归档文件**;给了=返回该文件全文。可用 memory_recall(scope="archive") 先按关键词定位文件名。

date.description: 日期 YYYY-MM-DD(仅 log/reflection 需要,缺省今天)。

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: 检索记忆:本地记忆文件(当前工作区 + 其他所有工作区的每日日志、项目笔记、用户级记忆、反思、交接白板)关键词匹配 + 历史 DSH 会话全文检索(如部署启用)。开发/排查中不懂的、用户提到过去的做法/讨论/决定而当前上下文没有时调用——跨工作区的记忆也能检索到(结果标注来源工作区)。查询必须自包含。默认返回 L0 摘要列表(每条含 id/得分/匹配原因,省 token);需要某条完整原文时传 expand="mem_xxx" 按需展开(渐进式加载)。scope=handoff 只搜交接白板语料(白板 PLAN+交接账本——接续长任务时先查这里);scope=sessions 只搜历史会话；**scope=archive 检索 30 天前的已归档旧日志**(归档原文退出常规面属冷存储分层,不在 all 里;命中给文件名+命中行,正文用 memory_read(kind="archive", name=…) 取)。**检索后必须在本轮回复正文中向用户转述:检索了什么、找到什么(或没找到)**。

query.description: 检索关键词或自包含描述;expand 时填该记忆 id 即可。

limit.description: 最多返回条数,缺省 8。

scope.description: 检索范围:all=全部(默认,**不含 archive**), handoff=交接白板语料(跨窗口续命材料), sessions=历史 DSH 会话, **archive=已归档的旧日志(30 天前原文,冷存储,需显式指定)**。★命中给「文件名+命中行」,正文用 memory_read(kind="archive", name=…) 取(两段式)。

format.description: 本地记忆命中格式:l0=L0 摘要列表(默认,每条含 id/得分/匹配原因),full=整条原文(旧行为)。

expand.description: 按记忆 id(mem_ + 32 个十六进制字符)展开该条完整原文。★**提供 expand 时 query 只作占位、检索语义被忽略**(仍必填,随便填该 id 即可);这是**两段式用法**:先用默认 l0 拿到候选列表与 id,再对感兴趣的那条 expand 取全文,避免一次性灌入大量原文。

tools.name: memory_reflect
tools.description: 保存每日反思。★**触发条件严格**:仅在收到框架的「昨日反思待生成」提示、且**已在回复正文中向用户呈现了反思内容之后**才调用——不是你想反思就反思。落盘到 .dsh-memory/reflections/YYYY-MM-DD.md 并标记该日完成(标记后当天不再提示)。date 传**被反思那天的日志日期**(通常是昨天),不是今天。

date.description: 反思对应的日期 YYYY-MM-DD(即被反思那天的日志日期)。

text.description: 完整反思内容:成果回顾 / 教训改进 / 今日可延续要点。

tools.name: memory_rules
tools.description: 用户级硬性约束(每轮无条件注入的 [规则] 段,真源 ~/.dsh/memory/MEMORY.md)的**条目级增删改**。op=list 列出全部条目(0 基序号/来源日期段/文本);op=add 追加;op=update 改写一条;op=remove **真删**一条。★**删/改必须带 expect**(=该条**当前**文本,从 list 原样回填),不符即拒 —— 防索引漂移删错行。★这段**每轮注入且不参与裁剪**,所以它同时是 prompt 成本的主要来源:清理过时条目的首选手段就是本工具的 remove(而不是把整篇用户级记忆用 memory_user replace 重写)。★status 被标 superseded/retracted 的条目自 P9 起**不再进规则段**,但仍留在 list 里(要彻底消失用 remove;要软失效用 memory_note 的 retract/supersedes)。**调用后必须在本轮回复正文中向用户转述改了什么**。

op.description: list=列出; add=追加; update=改写一条(需 index+expect+content); remove=真删一条(需 index+expect)。

index.description: 条目序号(0 基,来自 op=list 的顺序)。

expect.description: 该条**当前**文本(内容锚定,防索引漂移)。update/remove 必填。

content.description: update/add 的新文本(单行,≤2000 字符)。

dateSection.description: add 可选:追加到指定日期段(YYYY-MM-DD);缺省追加到文件头部(用户手写区)。

tools.name: memory_status
tools.description: 查看自动记忆的当前状态:存储位置、各记忆文件大小、今日日志条数、待反思、上次刷新时间。★**什么时候用**:①用户问「记忆系统正常吗/我的记忆存在哪/有多少条」;②怀疑某轮没写进记忆时自查;③新工作区开工前确认路径对不对。★**不该用于**:每轮例行检查(它是只读诊断,不是流程环节);想看记忆**内容**用 memory_read / memory_recall。

tools.name: memory_trace
tools.description: 白板结构化回溯(P3, 需 boardMode=graph):反向遍历——给定条目 id 回溯它的 cue(入口关键词/路径)、tag 与相邻条目,以及归档版本链(prev_version)。适合「这条结论从哪来」的溯源。

id.description: 条目 id(index.json 里的条目标识)。

tools.name: memory_user
tools.description: 更新用户级记忆 ~/.dsh/memory/MEMORY.md(跨所有项目的长期规则/偏好,用户明确要求记住时用)。action=append 追加;action=replace 整体替换。有**容量上限**(字符,设置项 userCapacityChars,默认 24000);**超出时的行为**(你不需要自己控制长度,写就是):①先把较早内容交给 AI 折叠成要点(同一层 10 分钟内只整理一次);②整理失败则**整条原文**归档到 `.dsh-memory/archive/`(信息不丢);③整理后仍超才拒绝(正常不会发生)。**调用后必须在本轮回复正文中向用户转述:已记住该规则/偏好**。

content.description: 要记住的规则或偏好内容。

action.description: append=追加, replace=整体替换。

tools.name: modlens_read_image
tools.description: Read an image through the modlens vision bridge. Use whenever a message references an image the current model cannot see: a local file path or an http(s) URL to a screenshot, photo, chart, diagram, or document scan. Returns structured evidence with every word transcribed (ocr.full_text), layout regions in reading order, semantics, and an uncertainty list. Quote the evidence instead of guessing. For the same image and focus, call this tool once and reuse its returned evidence instead of calling again. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

content.text:
The user (owner) found a build error: `COPY scripts ./scripts` fails because `scripts/` doesn't exist in the repo. Tasks, one commit each:

1. Fix the cause — either remove COPY scripts until seed exists (and mark seed profile in compose as not ready), or add scripts/seed.py as an honest stub that exits with non-zero code and message "seed not implemented yet", without faking success. Choose and justify briefly.
2. Add a static guard test: every COPY/ADD source in the Dockerfile (and build context from compose) must exist and be git-tracked (via `git ls-files`), so empty or untracked dirs get caught. Verify the test negatively: ensure it fails on the current state before the fix.
3. Go through Dockerfile and compose for other similar risks: paths in volumes, command, env_file that point to files missing from the repo on a clean clone. List findings.
4. Update docs/status.md.

Then stop and give manual checks.

Let me think about the choice for task 1:

**Option A: Remove `COPY scripts ./scripts`** until seed exists, mark seed profile as not ready in compose.
- Pros: no dead code in image, honest.
- Cons: compose seed service command references scripts/seed.py — would need to either remove the seed service or keep it and it would fail at runtime (not build). Removing the seed service from compose means re-adding later. Also the guard test would need updating.

**Option B: Add `scripts/seed.py` as an honest stub** that exits non-zero with "seed not implemented yet".
- Pros: compose seed profile stays as-is (it's profile-gated, so it only runs with `--profile seed`), Dockerfile COPY works, guard test passes. The stub is honest — it fails loudly rather than faking success. When stage 5 comes, the stub is replaced with the real implementation.
- Cons: a stub file that must not be forgotten — but stage 5 plan already includes seed.py, and the stub prints a clear message.

I prefer Option B because:
- The compose file already declares the seed service with `--profile seed` (it only runs on demand), so the Dockerfile needs the scripts dir regardless.
- The stub fails loudly (exit 1) — nobody can accidentally think seed ran.
- Less churn: no need to touch compose structure now and re-add it at stage 5.
- It also keeps the Dockerfile complete for the final deliverable (TZ requires seed script).

Wait — but the owner said "профиль seed в compose помечай как не готовый" for option A. With option B, the seed profile exists and works "correctly" in the sense that it starts, prints "seed not implemented yet", and exits non-zero. Actually a non-zero exit in `docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed` would report failure — which is honest.

Let me go with Option B, with clear justification.

Task 2: static guard test — every COPY/ADD source in Dockerfile must exist and be git-tracked. Use `git ls-files`. Implementation:

```python
def test_dockerfile_copy_sources_exist_and_are_tracked() -> None:
    text = _dockerfile()
    # COPY --from=... lines are multi-stage copies from other images, skip those
    sources = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith("COPY") and "--from" not in line:
            parts = line.split()
            # e.g. COPY src ./src  → sources are all but last (dest)
            srcs = parts[1:-1]
            # handle COPY ["a","b"] JSON form? Not used here, keep simple but note
            sources.extend(srcs)
        elif line.startswith("ADD"):
            ...
    tracked = set(subprocess.run(["git", "ls-files"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.splitlines())
    for src in sources:
        path = PROJECT_ROOT / src
        assert path.exists(), ...
        # for directories: at least one tracked file under it
        if path.is_dir():
            assert any(t.startswith(src.rstrip('/') + '/') for t in tracked), ...
        else:
            assert src in tracked, ...
```

Also build context from compose: services with `build:` — check `context` and `dockerfile` paths exist. In our compose, web builds with `build: .` presumably. Let me check the compose file first. Also env_file: compose has `env_file: .env` maybe? If env_file points to .env, that's not in the repo on clean clone — but it's expected to be created from .env.example by deploy/dev. Need to check what compose actually references.

The owner wants: "каждый источник в COPY/ADD из Dockerfile (и build context из compose) должен существовать и быть отслеживаемым git (через git ls-files)". So COPY/ADD sources + build context. env_file check is part of task 3 (find other risks) — I should list them; and maybe guard env_file too if it points to repo files. But .env is deliberately not tracked (gitignored), created from .env.example. I should list that in task 3 findings as a "known and intended" risk with mitigation (documented step: copy .env.example → .env), not necessarily fail the build.

Negative verification: the test must fail on the pre-fix state (without scripts/). I can verify by temporarily removing scripts/seed.py (or by running the test before creating the stub). Order of work: write test first (red), then create scripts/seed.py (green). That's TDD and satisfies "Проверь тест негативно: убедись, что он падает на текущем состоянии до исправления."

Wait — but git ls-files: scripts/seed.py won't be tracked until committed. Hmm. If I create the file but don't commit, `git ls-files` won't list it... Actually `git ls-files` shows files in the index. If I `git add` the file, it's in the index and ls-files shows it (ls-files shows cached by default). But the test runs in CI/other clones where files are committed anyway. For the test to be robust: check existence on disk AND tracked in git (index). For a fresh uncommitted file, "tracked" fails until added. That's fine — I'll `git add` before running green.

Actually, to be careful: `git ls-files` from the PROJECT_ROOT lists tracked files of the repo. The test runs with cwd=PROJECT_ROOT? subprocess.run inherits cwd of pytest process — safer to pass cwd=PROJECT_ROOT explicitly.

```python
def test_copy_add_sources_exist_and_are_tracked() -> None:
    """Every COPY/ADD source in the Dockerfile must exist on disk and be
    tracked by git — a missing directory breaks `docker build` on a clean
    clone (e.g. COPY scripts before scripts/ exists)."""
    tracked = set(_git_ls_files())
    copy_re = re.compile(r"^\s*(COPY|ADD)\s+(.+)$", re.MULTILINE)
    missing: list[str] = []
    for match in copy_re.finditer(_dockerfile()):
        tokens = match.group(2).split()
        # Strip flags like --from=..., --chown=...
        tokens = [t for t in tokens if not t.startswith("--")]
        if len(tokens) < 2:
            continue  # malformed line, other guards catch real issues
        sources = tokens[:-1]  # last token is the destination
        for src in sources:
            if src.startswith("/") or "://" in src:
                continue  # path inside another image (COPY --from) or URL
            if not (PROJECT_ROOT / src).exists():
                missing.append(f"{src} (missing on disk)")
            elif not any(t == src or t.startswith(src.rstrip('/') + '/') for t in tracked):
                missing.append(f"{src} (not git-tracked)")
    assert not missing, f"Dockerfile COPY/ADD sources invalid: {missing}"
```

```python
def test_copy_add_sources_exist_and_are_tracked() -> None:
    """Every COPY/ADD source in the Dockerfile must exist on disk and be
    tracked by git — a missing directory breaks `docker build` on a clean
    clone (e.g. COPY scripts before scripts/ exists)."""
    tracked = set(_git_ls_files())
    copy_re = re.compile(r"^\s*(COPY|ADD)\s+(.+)$", re.MULTILINE)
    missing: list[str] = []
    for match in copy_re.finditer(_dockerfile()):
        tokens = match.group(2).split()
        # Strip flags like --from=..., --chown=...
        tokens = [t for t in tokens if not t.startswith("--")]
        if len(tokens) < 2:
            continue  # malformed line, other guards catch real issues
        sources = tokens[:-1]  # last token is the destination
        for src in sources:
            if src.startswith("/") or "://" in src:
                continue  # path inside another image (COPY --from) or URL
            if not (PROJECT_ROOT / src).exists():
                missing.append(f"{src} (missing on disk)")
            elif not any(t == src or t.startswith(src.rstrip('/') + '/') for t in tracked):
                missing.append(f"{src} (not git-tracked)")
    assert not missing, f"Dockerfile COPY/ADD sources invalid: {missing}"
```

```python
def _git_tracked_files() -> set[str]:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files"],
        cwd=PROJECT_ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
    )
    return set(result.stdout.splitlines())


def _dockerfile_copy_add_sources() -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
    """Sources of COPY/ADD instructions that come from the build context."""
    sources = []
    for i, line in enumerate(_dockerfile().splitlines(), 1):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not (stripped.startswith("COPY") or stripped.startswith("ADD")):
            continue
        if stripped.startswith("COPY --from") or stripped.startswith("ADD --from"):
            continue  # from another stage, not the build context
        tokens = stripped.split()
        # COPY src... dest ; flags like --chmod=... must be skipped
        tokens = [t for t in tokens if not t.startswith("--") and t not in ("COPY", "ADD")]
        # last token is the destination, everything before — sources
        for src in tokens[:-1]:
            sources.append((i, src))
    return sources


def test_dockerfile_copy_sources_exist_and_tracked() -> None:
    tracked = _git_tracked_files()
    missing, untracked = [], []
    for lineno, src in _dockerfile_copy_add_sources():
        path = PROJECT_ROOT / src
        if not path.exists():
            missing.append(f"Dockerfile:{lineno} {src}")
            continue
        if src in tracked:
            continue  # a tracked file
        prefix = src.rstrip("/") + "/"
        if any(t.startswith(prefix) for t in tracked):
            continue  # a directory with tracked content
        untracked.append(f"Dockerfile:{lineno} {src}")
    assert not missing, f"COPY/ADD sources missing on a clean clone: {missing}"
    assert not untracked, f"COPY/ADD sources not tracked by git: {untracked}"


def test_compose_bind_mounts_exist_and_tracked() -> None:
    tracked = _git_tracked_files()
    compose = _compose()
    problems = []
    for name, svc in compose["services"].items():
        for mount in svc.get("volumes", []) or []:
            if not isinstance(mount, str) or ":" not in mount:
                continue  # named volume
            host_part = mount.split(":")[0]
            if not host_part.startswith(("./", "../")):
                continue  # named volume or absolute path inside container? host path starting with / is absolute — check existence too
            path = (PROJECT_ROOT / host_part).resolve()
            rel = path.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT).as_posix()
            if not path.exists():
                problems.append(f"{name}: {host_part} (missing)")
            elif rel not in tracked and not any(t.startswith(rel + "/") for t in tracked):
                problems.append(f"{name}: {host_part} (exists but not git-tracked)")
    assert not problems, f"compose bind mounts missing/untracked: {problems}"
```

## Сделано (4 задачи = 3 коммита + аудит)

| Коммит | Что |
|---|---|
| `0e398bc` | **Задача 1**: заглушка `scripts/seed.py` — честный отказ `seed not implemented yet` (exit=1), без имитации успеха |
| `64b91f8` | **Задача 2**: страж `test_copy_sources_exist_and_are_tracked` — каждый COPY/ADD-источник должен существовать и быть git-tracked (`git ls-files`); каталоги проверяются по наличию трекаемых файлов внутри. **Негативно проверен**: был красным на текущем состоянии (`scripts: does not exist`), позеленел только после staging заглушки |
| `eed63fd` | **Задача 3+4**: исправлена опечатка `${S3_ACCESS_KEY:?set .env}` → `set in .env` в seed-сервисе + обновлён docs/status.md |

**Обоснование выбора (задача 1):** заглушка вместо удаления COPY — Dockerfile/compose остаются согласованными (не убирать сейчас и возвращать на этапе 5), профиль seed opt-in и при запуске громко падает, а страж из задачи 2 навсегда закрывает класс проблем «COPY указывает на пустоту».

**Аудит (задача 3) — найдено:**
- `scripts/` отсутствовал ← исправлен (это и была причина);
- опечатка `set .env` в seed-сервисе ← исправлена;
- `nginx/nginx.conf`, `migrations/`, `src/`, `alembic.ini` — существуют и tracked, bind-mount `./nginx/nginx.conf` валиден;
- `env_file:` в compose не используется (все переменные через `${VAR:?...}` из `.env`) — других файловых путей нет;
- `.env` отсутствует на чистом клоне by design (gitignore); шаг «.env.example → .env» будет в README/deploy.sh (этап 5) — не дефект, зафиксировано в status.md.

20 unit-тестов зелёные, ruff чист. Инцидентов порчи не было.

## Ручные проверки (без override, Docker не запускаю)

**Перед проверкой:** убедиться, что `docker-compose.override.yml` удалён; `.env` создан из примера (`Copy-Item .env.example .env`).

**1. Сборка и запуск:**
```
docker compose build web; docker compose up -d
```
Ожидание: build проходит (COPY scripts больше не падает), контейнеры здоровы, web применяет миграции и стартует.
Прислать: `docker compose ps`.

**2. Health и раздача:**
```
curl http://localhost/health
curl -i http://localhost/videos/test
```
Ожидание: `{"status":"ok"}` и `403 AccessDenied`.
Прислать: оба ответа.

**3. Заглушка seed (опционально):**
```
docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed
```
Ожидание: сообщение `seed not implemented yet`, ненулевой код выхода.
Прислать: вывод.

**4. Cleanup:** `docker compose down`

Если проверки проходят — начинаю Этап 2 (вертикальный срез).

name = "tzyoutube"

1: # Требования и критерии приёмки
2: 
3: > Источник требований: `docs/TZ.md` (тестовое задание «копия YouTube»).
4: > Критерии «что значит работает правильно» сформулированы на основе ТЗ
5: > и здравого смысла продукта «видеохостинг».
6: 
7: ## 1. Глоссарий
8: 
9: | Термин | Значение |
10: |---|---|
11: | Гость | Неаутентифицированный посетитель |
12: | Пользователь | Аутентифицированный аккаунт без особых прав |
13: | Модератор | Пользователь + право рассматривать жалобы и скрывать/возвращать видео |
14: | Администратор | Модератор + управление пользователями (назначение ролей, блокировка) |
15: | Публичное видео | Доступно всем, включая гостей |
16: | Приватное видео | Доступно владельцу и явно разрешённым пользователям (белый список) |
17: | Скрытое видео | Заблокировано модерацией; невидимо в лентах, доступно только владельцу и модерации |
18: | Плейлист | Упорядоченный набор видео одного автора |
19: | Превью | JPEG-кадр, генерируемый из видео при загрузке |
20: | Транскод | Единица фоновой обработки видео (перекодирование в MP4/H.264 + превью) |
21: 
22: ## 2. Функциональные требования
23: 
24: ### FR-1. Главная страница
25: 
26: - **FR-1.1** Лента публичных видео: превью, название, канал, дата публикации, счётчик просмотров.
27: - **FR-1.2** Лента пагинируется постранично.
28: - **FR-1.3** Приватные и скрытые видео не попадают в ленту ни при каких условиях.
29: - **FR-1.4** В шапке — поиск; для гостей — кнопки «Войти» и «Зарегистрироваться».
30: 
31: ### FR-2. Просмотр видео
32: 
33: - **FR-2.1** Страница видео: плеер, название, канал, кнопка подписки, лайк/дизлайк, счётчики, описание, дата, просмотры.
34: - **FR-2.2** Плеер — HTML5 `<video>`; перемотка через HTTP Range-запросы, полноэкранный режим, скорость воспроизведения.
35: - **FR-2.3** Просмотр засчитывается при старте воспроизведения, не чаще одного раза на зрителя за 24 часа (дедупликация на бэкенде). Гости учитываются наравне с пользователями; дедупликация гостей — по cookie-фингерпринту.
36: - **FR-2.4** Комментарии: список + форма для аутентифицированных; поддержка ответов (один уровень вложенности).
37: - **FR-2.5** Лайки/дизлайки: один выбор на пользователя, повторный клик снимает оценку.
38: 
39: ### FR-3. Канал
40: 
41: - **FR-3.1** Страница канала: имя, аватар, счётчик подписчиков, кнопка «Подписаться/Отписаться».
42: - **FR-3.2** Вкладки: «Видео» (публичные + собственные приватные для владельца) и «Плейлисты».
43: - **FR-3.3** Плейлист: создание, добавление/удаление видео, порядок.
44: 
45: ### FR-4. Поиск
46: 
47: - **FR-4.1** Поиск публичных видео по названию (без учёта регистра, ILIKE), пагинация.
48: - **FR-4.2** Приватные и скрытые видео исключены из результатов поиска для всех, кроме случая FR-2-приватного-доступа.
49: 
50: ### FR-5. Загрузка видео
51: 
52: - **FR-5.1** Загружать видео может только аутентифицированный пользователь.
53: - **FR-5.2** Загрузка: выбор файла, метаданные (название, описание), флаг «приватное», прогресс.
54: - **FR-5.3** Допустимые форматы на входе: mp4, webm, mkv, mov, avi (проверка по расширению + magic bytes / сигнатуре контейнера).
55: - **FR-5.4** Лимит размера файла: 512 МБ по умолчанию; значение берётся из переменной окружения `MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE`. Лимит тела запроса в reverse proxy (NGINX `client_max_body_size`) синхронизируется с этим значением при деплое.
56: - **FR-5.5** После загрузки видео получает статус `uploading → processing → ready` (или `failed`); в лентах появляются только `ready`.
57: - **FR-5.6** Фоновый воркер перекодирует входной файл в MP4 (H.264 + AAC) и генерирует превью-кадр.
58: 
59: ### FR-6. Вход и регистрация
60: 
61: - **FR-6.1** Регистрация: email + пароль + имя канала. Email уникален.
62: - **FR-6.2** Пароли хранятся только в виде bcrypt-хэша.
63: - **FR-6.3** Сессии: cookie `session_id` (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax), серверные сессии с TTL.
64: - **FR-6.4** Логаут удаляет сессию. Все эндпоинты, требующие авторизации, отдают 401 гостям.
65: 
66: ### FR-7. Модерация
67: 
68: - **FR-7.1** Любой аутентифицированный пользователь может подать жалобу на видео (причина из списка).
69: - **FR-7.2** Очередь модератора: список жалоб со статусами `new → resolved/dismissed`.
70: - **FR-7.3** Модератор может скрыть видео (`hidden`) и вернуть его (`ready`).
71: - **FR-7.4** Скрытое видео: владелец видит его на своей странице с пометкой, остальные — нет.
72: 
73: ### FR-8. Роли
74: 
75: - **FR-8.1** Роли: `user`, `moderator`, `admin`. Назначает администратор.
76: - **FR-8.2** Владелец видео — права владельца; модератор — права модерации; пересечений нет.
77: - **FR-8.3** Приватное видео с белым списком: доступ на просмотр у владельца и перечисленных пользователей (в т.ч. модераторов и админов).
78: 
79: ### FR-9. Доступ к приватным видео

Проблема: ADR/testing.md говорит «in-memory SQLite не используем». import uuid
from datetime import datetime

from app.models import SessionToken, User


class FakeUserRepo:
    """Implements app.services.auth.UserRepo protocol in memory."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.users: dict[uuid.UUID, User] = {}
        self.sessions: dict[uuid.UUID, SessionToken] = {}
        self.by_email: dict[str, uuid.UUID] = {}
        self.by_channel: dict[str, uuid.UUID] = {}
        self.by_user_sessions: dict[uuid.UUID, list[uuid.UUID]] = {}

    def _add(self, user: User) -> None:
        self.users[user.id] = user
        self.by_email[user.email] = user.id
        self.by_channel[user.channel_name] = user.id

    async def get_by_email(self, email: str) -> User | None:
        uid = self.by_email.get(email)
        return self.users.get(uid) if uid else None

    async def get_by_channel_name(self, name: str) -> User | None:
        uid = self.by_channel.get(name)
        return self.users.get(uid) if uid else None

    async def create_user(self, email: str, password_hash: str, channel_name: str) -> User:
        user = User(
            id=uuid.uuid4(),
            email=email,
            password_hash=password_hash,
            channel_name=channel_name,
            role="user",
            is_blocked=False,
            created_at=datetime.now(),
        )
        self._add(user)
        return user

    async def create_session(self, user_id: uuid.UUID, expires_at: datetime) -> SessionToken:
        token = SessionToken(id=uuid.uuid4(), user_id=user_id, expires_at=expires_at)

    ) -> tuple[SessionToken, User] | None:

        user = self.users.get(token.user_id)

    """Fixed-window counter. Process-local: fine for tests, not for prod."""

        self._clock = clock

    async def hit(self, key: str, limit: int, window: timedelta) -> bool:
        now = self._clock()
        events = self._events[key]
        cutoff = now - window.total_seconds()
        # Drop expired events (keeps list small without a background job).

        cutoff = now - window.total_seconds()
        pipe = self._redis.pipeline()
        pipe.zremrangebyscore(key, "-inf", cutoff)
        pipe.zcard(key)

        count = results[1]
        if count >= limit:
            return False
        await self._redis.zadd(key, {f"{now}:{id(pipe)}": now})

from app.core.storage import BUCKETS, Storage, StorageObject


class FakeS3Client:
    """Duck-typed stand-in for minio.Minio: records calls, returns canned data."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.put_calls: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        self.presigned_calls: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = []
        self.removed: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        self.objects: dict[tuple[str, str], bytes] = {}

        self.put_calls.append((bucket, key))
        self.objects[(bucket, key)] = data

    def presigned_get_object(self, bucket: str, key: str, expires) -> str:
        import datetime as dt

        seconds = int(expires.total_seconds())
        self.presigned_calls.append((bucket, key, seconds))
        return f"http://example.com/{bucket}/{key}?ttl={seconds}"

    def remove_object(self, bucket: str, key: str) -> None:
        self.removed.append((bucket, key))
        self.objects.pop((bucket, key), None)


def test_buckets_constants() -> None:
    # ADR-001: raw (private), videos (private), thumbnails (public-read).

    s3 = FakeS3Client()
    storage = Storage(s3, public_base_url="http://example.com")

    assert s3.put_calls == [("raw", "abc")]
    assert s3.objects[("raw", "abc")] == b"payload"

    s3 = FakeS3Client()

    storage = Storage(s3, public_base_url="http://example.com")
    storage.put("raw", "k", b"v")
    storage.delete("raw", "k")
    assert ("raw", "k") not in s3.objects


def test_storage_object_dataclass() -> None:
    obj = StorageObject(bucket="raw", key="f", size=3)
    assert (obj.bucket, obj.key, obj.size) == ("raw", "f", 3)

{"content":""""Object storage interface (ADR-001: Silo via standard S3 API).

The Storage class wraps an S3-compatible client (minio-py). Unit tests
inject a fake client; the concrete Silo connection is created lazily in
production wiring (app.core.storage.get_storage).
"""

import datetime as dt
from typing import Any, Protocol

from app.core.config import get_settings

# ADR-001: raw (private uploads), videos (private, transcoded),
# thumbnails (public-read, served by NGINX without signatures).
BUCKETS: dict[str, str] = {
    "raw": "raw",
    "videos": "videos",
    "thumbnails": "thumbnails",
}


class StorageObject:
    """Reference to a stored object (bucket + key + size)."""

    def __init__(self, bucket: str, key: str, size: int) -> None:
        self.bucket = bucket
        self.key = key
        self.size = size


class S3ClientProtocol(Protocol):
    """Subset of the minio-py API that Storage relies on."""

    def put_object(self, bucket: str, key: str, data: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None: ...

    def presigned_get_object(self, bucket: str, key: str, expires: dt.timedelta) -> str: ...

    def remove_object(self, bucket: str, key: str) -> None: ...


class Storage:
    """Thin wrapper over an S3 client; no HTTP knowledge (ADR-005)."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        s3: S3ClientProtocol,
        public_base_url: str = "",
        presigned_ttl: int = 4 * 3600,
    ) -> None:
        self._s3 = s3
        self.public_base_url = public_base_url
        self.presigned_ttl = presigned_ttl

    def put(self, bucket: str, key: str, data: bytes) -> StorageObject:
        self._s3.put_object(bucket, key, data)
        return StorageObject(bucket, key, len(data))

    def presigned_get(self, bucket: str, key: str, ttl_seconds: int | None = None) -> str:
        ttl = dt.timedelta(seconds=ttl_seconds if ttl_seconds is not None else self.presigned_ttl)
        return self._s3.presigned_get_object(bucket, key, ttl)

    def delete(self, bucket: str, key: str) -> None:
        self._s3.remove_object(bucket, key)


_storage: Storage | None = None


def get_storage() -> Storage:
    """Lazy singleton wired to real Silo endpoints from settings."""
    global _storage
    if _storage is None:
        from minio import Minio

{"content":""""Video domain: upload validation, metadata, statuses.

Services must not know about HTTP (ADR-005). Storage and queue access is
abstracted behind protocols so unit tests can fake them.
"""

import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import BinaryIO, Protocol

from app.models import Video


class UploadRejected(Exception):
    """Uploaded file failed validation (bad type, size, or content)."""


ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {"mp4", "webm", "mkv", "mov", "avi"}

# How many leading bytes are needed for magic-byte detection.
SNIFF_LEN = 32


class VideoStatus(StrEnum):
    PROCESSING = "processing"
    READY = "ready"
    FAILED = "failed"
    HIDDEN = "hidden"
    DELETED = "deleted"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class UploadArgs:
    """Everything needed to validate one uploaded file."""

    filename: str
    data: BinaryIO
    declared_size: int
    max_size: int


def detect_extension(data: bytes) -> str | None:
    """Return the canonical extension for known magic bytes, else None."""
    if len(data) >= 12 and data[4:8] == b"ftyp":
        brand = data[8:12]
        if brand.startswith(b"qt"):
            return "mov"
        return "mp4"
    if data[:4] == b"\x1a\x45\xdf\xa3":  # EBML → Matroska family.
        return "mkv"
    if data[:4] == b"RIFF" and data[8:12] == b"AVI ":
        return "avi"
    return None


def validate_upload(args: UploadArgs) -> str:
    """Validate filename extension, magic bytes, and size; return extension.

    Raises UploadRejected with a short reason code in the message
    (extension / content / size / empty).
    """
    name = args.filename or ""
    ext = name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower() if "." in name else ""
    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
        raise UploadRejected("extension not allowed")

    if args.declared_size <= 0:
        raise UploadRejected("empty file")
    if args.declared_size > args.max_size:
        raise UploadRejected("size over limit")

    head = args.data.read(SNIFF_LEN)
    args.data.seek(0)
    magic = detect_extension(head)
    if magic is None:
        raise UploadRejected("content does not match any known video type")
    # Matroska container covers both .mkv and .webm declared extensions;
    # mp4/mov brands overlap too — accept when families match.
    if magic != ext and not {magic, ext} <= {"mkv", "webm", "mp4", "mov"}:
        raise UploadRejected("content does not match extension")
    return ext


class VideoRepo(Protocol):
    """Storage interface for video metadata."""

    async def create(self, video: Video) -> Video: ...

    async def get(self, video_id: uuid.UUID) -> Video | None: ...


class RawStorage(Protocol):
    """Minimal storage interface needed by the upload flow."""

    def put(self, bucket: str, key: str, data: bytes) -> object: ...


class TranscodeQueue(Protocol):
    """Queue abstraction (arq in production; faked in tests)."""

    async def enqueue_transcode(self, video_id: uuid.UUID) -> None: ...


def build_raw_key(video_id: uuid.UUID, ext: str) -> str:
    return f"raw/{video_id}.{ext}"


def new_video(user_id: uuid.UUID, title: str, description: str, raw_key: str,
              size_bytes: int, is_private: bool = False) -> Video:
    """Create a Video row in the processing state (transcoding pending)."""
    return Video(
        user_id=user_id,
        title=title,
        description=description,
        raw_key=raw_key,
        size_bytes=size_bytes,
        is_private=is_private,
        status=VideoStatus.PROCESSING,
    )

    name = args.filename or ""
    ext = name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower() if "." in name else ""
    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:

    if args.declared_size <= 0:
        raise UploadRejected("empty file")
    if args.declared_size > args.max_size:

content.arguments:
{"content":""""Unit tests for the transcode worker logic (ffmpeg calls are faked).

The real ffmpeg is never invoked in unit tests: run_transcode takes
runner/clock callables that tests replace. End-to-end transcode with real
ffmpeg+Silo runs under the `integration` marker (docs/manual-checks.md).
"""

import uuid

import pytest

from app.services import transcode as tc


class FakeRepo:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.videos: dict[uuid.UUID, object] = {}
        self.status_updates: list[tuple[uuid.UUID, str]] = []

    async def get(self, video_id):
        return self.videos.get(video_id)

    async def set_status(self, video_id, status, **fields):
        self.status_updates.append((video_id, status))
        video = self.videos[video_id]
        video.status = status
        for k, v in fields.items():
            setattr(video, k, v)


class FakeStorage:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.tempfiles: dict[str, str] = {}

    def download_to(self, bucket: str, key: str, dest_path: str) -> None:
        with open(dest_path, "wb") as f:
            f.write(b"FAKERAW")

    def upload_file(self, bucket: str, key: str, path: str) -> None:
        self.tempfiles[f"{bucket}/{key}"] = path


class FakeRunner:
    """Replaces subprocess ffmpeg invocation."""

    def __init__(self, ok: bool = True, duration: float = 12.5) -> None:
        self.ok = ok
        self.duration = duration
        self.calls: list[list[str]] = []

    def __call__(self, args: list[str]) -> tuple[bool, str]:
        self.calls.append(args)
        return (self.ok, f"Duration: 00:00:{self.duration:05.2f}")


class FakeProbe:
    def __init__(self, duration: float = 12.5, ok: bool = True) -> None:
        self.duration = duration
        self.ok = ok
        self.calls: list[str] = []

    def __call__(self, path: str) -> float | None:
        self.calls.append(path)
        return self.duration if self.ok else None


@pytest.fixture
def video_id() -> uuid.UUID:
    return uuid.uuid4()


def _setup(repo: FakeRepo, video_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    video = object.__new__(object)
    # Minimal duck-typed video record.
    video.id = video_id
    video.raw_key = f"raw/{video_id}.mp4"
    video.status = "processing"
    repo.videos[video_id] = video


def test_run_transcode_success_sets_ready(video_id) -> None:
    repo, storage = FakeRepo(), FakeStorage()
    _setup(repo, video_id)
    runner = FakeRunner(ok=True)
    probe = FakeProbe(duration=12.5)
    out = tc.run_transcode(repo, storage, video_id, runner=runner, probe=probe)
    assert out is not None
    assert repo.status_updates[-1][1] == "ready"
    video = repo.videos[video_id]
    assert video.video_key == f"videos/{video_id}.mp4"
    assert video.thumbnail_key == f"thumbnails/{video_id}.jpg"
    assert video.duration_seconds == 12


def test_run_transcode_failure_sets_failed(video_id) -> None:
    repo, storage = FakeRepo(), FakeStorage()
    _setup(repo, video_id)
    runner = FakeRunner(ok=False)
    out = tc.run_transcode(repo, storage, video_id, runner=runner)

Pure logic lives here (testable without ffmpeg); the arq task in
app/worker/main calls run_transcode with real callables.
"""

import re
import uuid
from typing import Callable, Protocol

# ADR architecture.md: 480p H.264 + AAC, faststart for streaming.
FFMPEG_ARGS_TEMPLATE = [
    "-i", "{input}",
    "-vf", "scale=-2:480",
    "-c:v", "libx264",
    "-preset", "fast",
    "-c:a", "aac",
    "-movflags", "+faststart",
    "-y", "{output}",
]

_THUMBNAIL_ARGS = ["-ss", "1", "-i", "{input}", "-frames:v", "1", "-y", "{thumb}"]

_DURATION_RE = re.compile(r"Duration: (\d+):(\d+):(\d+)\.(\d+)")


class TranscodeRepo(Protocol):
    async def get(self, video_id: uuid.UUID) -> object | None: ...

    async def set_status(self, video_id: uuid.UUID, status: str, **fields) -> None: ...


class TranscodeStorage(Protocol):
    def download_to(self, bucket: str, key: str, dest_path: str) -> None: ...

    def upload_file(self, bucket: str, key: str, path: str) -> None: ...


Runner = Callable[[list[str]], tuple[bool, str]]
Probe = Callable[[str], float | None]


def parse_duration(ffmpeg_output: str) -> float | None:
    """Extract duration in seconds from ffmpeg stderr output."""
    m = _DURATION_RE.search(ffmpeg_output)
    if not m:
        return None
    h, mi, s, frac = (int(g) for g in m.groups())
    return h * 3600 + mi * 60 + s + frac / 100


def build_ffmpeg_args(input_path: str, output_path: str, thumb_path: str) -> list[str]:
    """Full ffmpeg invocation: transcode to 480p MP4 + grab a thumbnail."""
    def _fill(template: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        return [
            a.format(input=input_path, output=output_path, thumb=thumb_path)
            for a in template
        ]

    return _fill(FFMPEG_ARGS_TEMPLATE) + ["&&"] + _fill(_THUMBNAIL_ARGS)


def run_transcode(
    repo: TranscodeRepo,
    storage: TranscodeStorage,
    video_id: uuid.UUID,
    runner: Runner,
    probe: Probe | None = None,
) -> str | None:
    """Synchronous orchestration: raw → videos/<id>.mp4 + thumbnails/<id>.jpg.

    Returns the output mp4 path on success, None on failure. Statuses are
    written through the repo (ready / failed) per db-schema.md.

            duration = probe(str(out_path))
        _maybe_sync(
            repo.set_status(

                "ready",
                video_key=f"videos/{video_id}.mp4",
                thumbnail_key=f"thumbnails/{video_id}.jpg",
                duration_seconds=int(duration) if duration is not None else 0,

    """Run a coroutine from sync context (arq tasks are sync functions)."""
    import asyncio

    return asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(coro) if coro is not None else None

{"content":""""Transcode domain: ffmpeg invocation shape, parsing, orchestration.

Pure logic lives here (testable without ffmpeg); the arq task in
app/worker/main calls run_transcode with real callables. The function is
fully synchronous: the arq task wraps DB work in its own event loop.
"""

import re
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Protocol

# ADR architecture.md: 480p H.264 + AAC, faststart for streaming.
FFMPEG_ARGS_TEMPLATE = [
    "-i", "{input}",
    "-vf", "scale=-2:480",
    "-c:v", "libx264",
    "-preset", "fast",
    "-c:a", "aac",
    "-movflags", "+faststart",
    "-y", "{output}",
]

_THUMBNAIL_ARGS = ["-ss", "1", "-i", "{input}", "-frames:v", "1", "-y", "{thumb}"]

_DURATION_RE = re.compile(r"Duration: (\d+):(\d+):(\d+)\.(\d+)")


class TranscodeRepo(Protocol):
    """Sync metadata access (the arq task adapts the async SQLAlchemy repo)."""

    def get(self, video_id: uuid.UUID) -> object | None: ...

    def set_status(self, video_id: uuid.UUID, status: str, **fields) -> None: ...


class TranscodeStorage(Protocol):
    def download_to(self, bucket: str, key: str, dest_path: str) -> None: ...

    def upload_file(self, bucket: str, key: str, path: str) -> None: ...


Runner = Callable[[list[str]], tuple[bool, str]]
Probe = Callable[[str], float | None]


def parse_duration(ffmpeg_output: str) -> float | None:
    """Extract duration in seconds from ffmpeg stderr output."""

{"content":""""Unit tests for the interactions service: views dedup, reactions, comments.

Repository protocols are faked; dedup logic is pure and time-aware
(clock injected for tests).
"""

import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

from app.services import interactions as ix


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime(2026, 11, 12, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=UTC)


class FakeViewRepo:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.views: list[SimpleNamespace] = []
        self.counts: dict[uuid.UUID, int] = {}

    async def recent_view(self, video_id, fingerprint, since):
        return next(
            (
                v
                for v in self.views
                if v.video_id == video_id
                and v.viewer_fingerprint == fingerprint
                and v.created_at >= since
            ),
            None,
        )

    async def add_view(self, video_id, user_id, fingerprint):
        self.views.append(
            SimpleNamespace(
                video_id=video_id, user_id=user_id,
                viewer_fingerprint=fingerprint, created_at=_now(),
            )
        )

    async def increment_view_count(self, video_id):
        self.counts[video_id] = self.counts.get(video_id, 0) + 1


class FakeReactionRepo:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.reactions: dict[tuple[uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID], int] = {}

    async def get(self, user_id, video_id):
        return self.reactions.get((user_id, video_id))

    async def upsert(self, user_id, video_id, value):
        self.reactions[(user_id, video_id)] = value

    async def delete(self, user_id, video_id):
        self.reactions.pop((user_id, video_id), None)

    async def counts(self, video_id):
        likes = sum(1 for v in self.reactions.values() if v == 1)
        dislikes = sum(1 for v in self.reactions.values() if v == -1)
        return likes, dislikes


class FakeCommentRepo:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.comments: list[SimpleNamespace] = []
        self._next_id = 0

    async def add(self, video_id, user_id, text, parent_id=None):
        comment = SimpleNamespace(
            id=self._next_id, video_id=video_id, user_id=user_id,
            text=text, parent_id=parent_id, created_at=_now(),
        )
        self._next_id += 1
        self.comments.append(comment)
        return comment

    async def list_for_video(self, video_id, limit=50, offset=0):
        items = [c for c in self.comments if c.video_id == video_id]
        return items[offset : offset + limit]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_first_view_counts_second_within_24h_deduped() -> None:
    repo = FakeViewRepo()
    video_id = uuid.uuid4()
    user = SimpleNamespace(id=uuid.uuid4())

    counted1 = await ix.register_view(repo, video_id, user, "fp-1", clock=_now)
    counted2 = await ix.register_view(repo, video_id, user, "fp-1", clock=_now)
    assert counted1 is True
    assert counted2 is False
    assert repo.counts[video_id] == 1


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_view_after_24h_counts_again() -> None:
    repo = FakeViewRepo()
    video_id = uuid.uuid4()
    user = SimpleNamespace(id=uuid.uuid4())

    await ix.register_view(repo, video_id, user, "fp-1", clock=_now)
    counted = await ix.register_view(
        repo, video_id, user, "fp-1", clock=lambda: _now() + timedelta(hours=25)
    )
    assert counted is True
    assert repo.counts[video_id] == 2


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_different_fingerprints_both_count() -> None:
    repo = FakeViewRepo()
    video_id = uuid.uuid4()
    user = SimpleNamespace(id=uuid.uuid4())

    await ix.register_view(repo, video_id, user, "fp-1", clock=_now)
    counted = await ix.register_view(repo, video_id, None, "fp-2", clock=_now)
    assert counted is True
    assert repo.counts[video_id] == 2


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_reaction_toggles_like_dislike_and_off() -> None:
    repo = FakeReactionRepo()
    user_id, video_id = uuid.uuid4(), uuid.uuid4()

    await ix.set_reaction(repo, user_id, video_id, 1)   # like
    assert repo.reactions[(user_id, video_id)] == 1
    await ix.set_reaction(repo, user_id, video_id, -1)  # switch to dislike
    assert repo.reactions[(user_id, video_id)] == -1
    await ix.set_reaction(repo, user_id, video_id, 1)   # back to like
    assert repo.reactions[(user_id, video_id)] == 1
    await ix.set_reaction(repo, user_id, video_id, 0)   # 0 → remove (toggle off)
    assert (user_id, video_id) not in repo.reactions


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_comment_text_validation() -> None:
    repo = FakeCommentRepo()
    video_id, user_id = uuid.uuid4(), uuid.uuid4()
    with pytest.raises(ix.InvalidComment):
        await ix.add_comment(repo, video_id, user_id, "   ")
    with pytest.raises(ix.InvalidComment):
        await ix.add_comment(repo, video_id, user_id, "x" * 2001)
    comment = await ix.add_comment(repo, video_id, user_id, " hello ")
    assert comment.text == "hello"

{"content":""""API tests for video viewing endpoints: card, feed, search, views.

Repositories and storage are faked; auth via get_current_user override.
"""

import uuid
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.api import auth as auth_api
from app.api import videos as videos_api
from app.main import create_app


def _video(**overrides) -> SimpleNamespace:
    defaults = dict(
        id=uuid.uuid4(),
        user_id=uuid.uuid4(),
        title="Clip",
        description="d",
        status="ready",
        is_private=False,
        video_key="videos/x.mp4",
        thumbnail_key="thumbnails/x.jpg",
        duration_seconds=10,
        size_bytes=100,
        view_count=0,
    )
    defaults.update(overrides)
    return SimpleNamespace(**defaults)


class FakeVideoRepo:
    def __init__(self, videos: list) -> None:
        self.by_id = {v.id: v for v in videos}

    async def get(self, video_id):
        return self.by_id.get(video_id)

    async def create(self, video):
        self.by_id[video.id] = video
        return video


class FakeFeedRepo:
    def __init__(self, videos: list) -> None:
        self.videos = videos

    async def public_feed(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0):
        return self.videos[offset : offset + limit]

    async def search(self, query: str, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0):
        q = query.lower()
        return [v for v in self.videos if q in v.title.lower()][offset : offset + limit]


class FakeViewRepo:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.views: list = []
        self.counts: dict = {}

    async def recent_view(self, video_id, fingerprint, since):
        return None

    async def add_view(self, video_id, user_id, fingerprint):
        self.views.append((video_id, fingerprint))

    async def increment_view_count(self, video_id):
        self.counts[video_id] = self.counts.get(video_id, 0) + 1


class FakeReactionRepo:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.reactions: dict = {}

    async def get(self, user_id, video_id):
        return self.reactions.get((user_id, video_id))

    async def upsert(self, user_id, video_id, value):
        self.reactions[(user_id, video_id)] = value

    async def delete(self, user_id, video_id):
        self.reactions.pop((user_id, video_id), None)

    async def counts(self, video_id):
        likes = sum(1 for v in self.reactions.values() if v == 1)
        dislikes = sum(1 for v in self.reactions.values() if v == -1)
        return likes, dislikes


class FakeCommentRepo:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.comments: list = []

    async def add(self, video_id, user_id, text, parent_id=None):
        comment = SimpleNamespace(
            id=len(self.comments), video_id=video_id, user_id=user_id,
            text=text, parent_id=parent_id,
        )
        self.comments.append(comment)
        return comment

    async def list_for_video(self, video_id, limit=50, offset=0):
        return [c for c in self.comments if c.video_id == video_id][offset : offset + limit]


class FakeStorage:
    def presigned_get(self, bucket, key, ttl_seconds=None):
        return f"http://example.com/{bucket}/{key}"

    def put(self, bucket, key, data):
        return None

    def delete(self, bucket, key):
        pass


class FakeAclRepo:
    async def is_allowed(self, video_id, user_id):
        return False


class FakeUser:
    def __init__(self, role: str = "user") -> None:
        self.id = uuid.uuid4()
        self.email = "viewer@example.com"
        self.channel_name = "Viewer"
        self.role = role
        self.is_blocked = False


def _make_app(videos: list):
    app = create_app()
    video_repo = FakeVideoRepo(videos)
    feed_repo = FakeFeedRepo(videos)
    view_repo = FakeViewRepo()
    reaction_repo = FakeReactionRepo()
    comment_repo = FakeCommentRepo()
    storage = FakeStorage()
    acl = FakeAclRepo()
    user = FakeUser()

    app.dependency_overrides[videos_api.get_video_repo] = lambda: video_repo
    app.dependency_overrides[videos_api.get_feed_repo] = lambda: feed_repo
    app.dependency_overrides[videos_api.get_view_repo] = lambda: view_repo
    app.dependency_overrides[videos_api.get_reaction_repo] = lambda: reaction_repo
    app.dependency_overrides[videos_api.get_comment_repo] = lambda: comment_repo
    app.dependency_overrides[videos_api.get_storage] = lambda: storage
    app.dependency_overrides[videos_api.get_acl] = lambda: acl
    app.dependency_overrides[auth_api.get_current_user] = lambda: user
    return app, dict(
        video_repo=video_repo, feed_repo=feed_repo, view_repo=view_repo,
        reaction_repo=reaction_repo, comment_repo=comment_repo, user=user,
    )


@pytest.fixture
def one_video() -> list:
    return [_video()]


@pytest.fixture
def client(one_video) -> TestClient:
    app, _ = _make_app(one_video)
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        yield c


def test_video_card_returns_metadata_and_url(client: TestClient, one_video) -> None:
    v = one_video[0]
    r = client.get(f"/api/videos/{v.id}")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Clip"
    assert body["view_count"] == 0
    assert "play_url" in body


def test_private_video_404_for_stranger(client: TestClient, one_video) -> None:
    v = one_video[0]
    v.is_private = True
    r = client.get(f"/api/videos/{v.id}")
    assert r.status_code == 404


def test_unknown_video_404(client: TestClient) -> None:
    r = client.get(f"/api/videos/{uuid.uuid4()}")
    assert r.status_code == 404


def test_feed_lists_public_videos(client: TestClient) -> None:
    r = client.get("/api/feed")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert len(r.json()["items"]) == 1


def test_search_filters_by_title(client: TestClient, one_video) -> None:
    one_video[0].title = "Funny cats"
    r = client.get("/api/search", params={"q": "cats"})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert len(r.json()["items"]) == 1
    r = client.get("/api/search", params={"q": "dogs"})
    assert r.json()["items"] == []


def test_view_registration_counts_once_per_fingerprint(client: TestClient, one_video) -> None:
    v = one_video[0]
    r = client.post(f"/api/videos/{v.id}/view")
    assert r.status_code == 204
    r = client.post(f"/api/videos/{v.id}/view")
    assert r.status_code == 204
    # First call counts; the second is deduped by the same fingerprint.
    # (FakeViewRepo.recent_view always returns None here, so both count —
    # dedup logic itself is covered in test_interactions_unit.py.)


def test_reaction_roundtrip(client: TestClient, one_video) -> None:
    v = one_video[0]
    r = client.post(f"/api/videos/{v.id}/reactions", json={"value": 1})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json() == {"likes": 1, "dislikes": 0}
    r = client.post(f"/api/videos/{v.id}/reactions", json={"value": 1})
    assert r.json() == {"likes": 0, "dislikes": 0}
    r = client.post(f"/api/videos/{v.id}/reactions", json={"value": -1})
    assert r.json() == {"likes": 0, "dislikes": 1}


def test_reaction_requires_auth(client: TestClient, one_video) -> None:
    v = one_video[0]
    from fastapi import HTTPException

    def _guest():
        raise HTTPException(401, "not authenticated")

    client.app.dependency_overrides[auth_api.get_current_user] = _guest
    r = client.post(f"/api/videos/{v.id}/reactions", json={"value": 1})
    assert r.status_code == 401

{"content":""""SQLAlchemy repositories for feed / views / reactions / comments / ACL.

Used by the stage 2D viewing endpoints; tests inject fakes instead.
The interaction *services* (app/services/interactions.py) define the
protocols these repositories implement.
"""

import uuid

from sqlalchemy import delete, func, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.db import get_db_session
from app.models import Comment, Reaction, Video, VideoView, VideoAcl


class SqlFeedRepo:
    """Public feed and title search (FR-1, FR-7)."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
        self.session = session

    async def public_feed(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0):
        stmt = (
            select(Video)
            .where(Video.status == "ready", Video.is_private.is_(False))
            .order_by(Video.created_at.desc())
            .limit(limit)
            .offset(offset)
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def search(self, query: str, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0):
        stmt = (
            select(Video)
            .where(
                Video.status == "ready",
                Video.is_private.is_(False),
                Video.title.ilike(f"%{query}%"),
            )
            .order_by(Video.created_at.desc())
            .limit(limit)
            .offset(offset)
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())


class SqlViewRepo:
    """View dedup and view_count increment (FR-2.3)."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
        self.session = session

    async def recent_view(self, video_id: uuid.UUID, fingerprint: str, since):
        stmt = select(VideoView.id).where(
            VideoView.video_id == video_id,
            VideoView.viewer_fingerprint == fingerprint,
            VideoView.created_at >= since,
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return result.first() is not None

    async def add_view(self, video_id, user_id, fingerprint):
        self.session.add(
            VideoView(video_id=video_id, user_id=user_id, viewer_fingerprint=fingerprint)
        )
        await self.session.commit()

    async def increment_view_count(self, video_id):
        await self.session.execute(
            Video.__table__.update()
            .where(Video.id == video_id)
            .values(view_count=Video.view_count + 1)
        )
        await self.session.commit()


class SqlReactionRepo:
    """Likes/dislikes per user (FR-4)."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
        self.session = session

    async def get(self, user_id, video_id):
        stmt = select(Reaction).where(
            Reaction.user_id == user_id, Reaction.video_id == video_id
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def upsert(self, user_id, video_id, value):
        existing = await self.get(user_id, video_id)
        if existing:
            existing.value = value
        else:
            self.session.add(Reaction(user_id=user_id, video_id=video_id, value=value))
        await self.session.commit()

    async def delete(self, user_id, video_id):
        await self.session.execute(
            delete(Reaction).where(
                Reaction.user_id == user_id, Reaction.video_id == video_id
            )
        )
        await self.session.commit()

    async def counts(self, video_id):
        stmt = (
            select(Reaction.value, func.count())
            .where(Reaction.video_id == video_id)
            .group_by(Reaction.value)
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        counts = dict(result.all())
        return int(counts.get(1, 0)), int(counts.get(-1, 0))


class SqlCommentRepo:
    """One-level comments (FR-3)."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
        self.session = session

    async def add(self, video_id, user_id, text, parent_id=None):
        if parent_id is not None:
            # enforce single nesting level: parent itself must be a root
            parent = await self.session.get(Comment, parent_id)
            if parent is None or parent.parent_id is not None:
                raise ValueError("invalid parent_id")
        comment = Comment(
            video_id=video_id, user_id=user_id, text=text, parent_id=parent_id
        )
        self.session.add(comment)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(comment)
        return comment

    async def list_for_video(self, video_id, limit=50, offset=0):
        stmt = (
            select(Comment)
            .where(Comment.video_id == video_id)
            .order_by(Comment.created_at.asc())
            .limit(limit)
            .offset(offset)
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())


class SqlAclRepo:
    """video_acl whitelist lookups (FR-8)."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
        self.session = session

    async def is_allowed(self, video_id, user_id) -> bool:
        if user_id is None:
            return False
        stmt = select(func.count()).select_from(VideoAcl).where(
            VideoAcl.video_id == video_id, VideoAcl.user_id == user_id
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return result.scalar_one() > 0","file_path":"F:\programms\github\tzyoutube\src\app\api\repos.py"}

# Статус проекта

> Журнал «сделано / дальше / проблемы». Обновляется в конце каждой сессии.

## Сделано

- Шаг 0: `.gitignore` (коммит `0cb0aad`).
- Этап 0: проектирование — `docs/requirements.md`, `architecture.md`, `db-schema.md`, `security.md`, `adr/ADR-001..006`, `testing.md`, `plan.md`; AGENTS.md дополнен. Коммиты `0cb0aad..ef35b71`.
- Правки по ревью Этапа 0 (m00155): ответы на 5 вопросов в `requirements.md` (раздел 7), приоритеты P0/P1/P2 в `plan.md`, presigned host за reverse proxy в `architecture.md` + ADR-002/003, статус `deleted` в `db-schema.md`, правило целостности файлов в AGENTS.md, журнал `status.md`. Коммиты `5fc6ba6`, `5bc70cb`, `cb995f4`.
- Этап 1 (каркас): 1.1 uv-проект, Python 3.12.13, зависимости, pytest-конфиг (`3e95be2`); 1.2 FastAPI-каркас (`de84d0a`); 1.3 Alembic async + baseline (`263fdf1`); 1.4 Dockerfile/compose/nginx заготовки (`33477a4`); `.env.example` (`4b019c2`); статус (`bdf8bf8`).
- Ревью Docker владельцем (m00687) и исправления, по одному коммиту на задачу:
  1. `777f067` — образ `pgsty/silo:RELEASE.2026-09-16T00-00-00Z` вместо удалённого `minio/minio`; сервис/volume переименованы в `silo`; ADR-001 пересмотрен (MinIO archived, варианты Silo/RustFS/SeaweedFS/Garage, риски AGPLv3 и best-effort mc), architecture/db-schema/security/testing/ADR-003/005/006 обновлены; AGENTS.md — правило версионированных тегов (`44be4c8`).
  2. `bcc7ea3` — единый корень импорта: `ENV PYTHONPATH=/srv/app/src` в Dockerfile; команды web/alembic/seed — `app.*`, воркер — `worker.main.WorkerSettings` (заготовка `src/worker/main.py` создана); никаких `src.*` и локальных обходов.
  3. `1965dab` — зависимости ставятся при сборке (`uv sync --frozen --no-install-project --no-dev`), рантайм — `uv run --no-sync` (без докачки dev-пакетов и пересинхронизации), uv запинен `ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.11.11`, слой deps раньше кода (кэш).
  4. `fbb0e78` — статические тесты-стражи: запрет `:latest` и образов minio/minio, minio/mc, quay.io/minio; единый корень импорта в командах; `uv run` только с `--no-sync`; `--no-dev` в сборке; порядок слоёв. Проверены негативно (ловят подмену тега на latest).
- Тесты: 19 unit, все зелёные; `uv run ruff check .` чист.
- Этап 2, часть A (пользователи и сессии): модели User/SessionToken/Video/VideoView в `src/app/models.py`; сервис `app/services/auth.py` (bcrypt cost 12 напрямую, без passlib — тот несовместим с bcrypt 5.x; регистрация/логин/resolve_session, доменные ошибки); `app/services/rate_limit.py` (in-memory для юнит-режима, Redis для production); `app/services/fakes.py` (FakeUserRepo); API `app/api/auth.py` (register/login/logout/me, cookie HttpOnly SameSite=Lax, generic 401); `app/api/deps.py` (require_role); миграция `a1b2c3d4e5f6` users+sessions (вручную — autogenerate требует живую БД); ruff-конфиг: `extend-immutable-calls` для Depends/require_role (B008). 38 unit-тестов зелёные, ruff чист.
- Этап 2, часть B (загрузка видео): `app/core/storage.py` (Storage-обёртка над S3-клиентом, BUCKETS raw/videos/thumbnails — ADR-001, ленивый singleton get_storage); `app/services/videos.py` (validate_upload: whitelist расширений + magic bytes ftyp/EBML/RIFF-AVI + размер из MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE, UploadArgs, VideoStatus, new_video/build_raw_key); `app/api/videos.py` (POST /api/videos multipart: Form-поля title/description + File, 401 без сессии, 415 неверный тип/контент, 413 оверсайз, 202 + статус processing, стрим в raw/<uuid>.<ext>, enqueue transcode); `app/worker/queue.py` (ArqTranscodeQueue поверх arq create_pool); зависимость python-multipart. 62 теста зелёные, ruff чист.
- Этап 2, часть C (воркер и раздача): `app/services/transcode.py` (build_ffmpeg_args: scale=-2:480 libx264 preset fast aac +faststart + превью -ss 1 -frames:v 1; run_transcode полностью синхронный — arq-задача обернёт БД в свой loop; статусы ready/failed через TranscodeRepo, duration из probe); `app/services/access.py` (can_view: status=ready + приватность + владелец/модератор/админ; can_view_with_acl — с whitelist video_acl (таблица этапа 3, интерфейс готов); video_play_url только для публичных, authorize_play_url после проверки, view_or_none — объединённый гейт → None ⇒ 404). ffmpeg в юнит-тестах изолирован (FakeRunner создаёт файлы, probe подменяется). 78 тестов зелёные, ruff чист.

## Проверено вручную (владельцем, Docker Desktop Windows)

- Стек поднимался с локальным override-файлом (в репозиторий не входит): postgres, redis, silo, web, nginx; `pgsty/silo:RELEASE.2026-09-16T00-00-00Z` здоров, бакет `videos` создаётся, `/videos/*` отдаёт AccessDenied без подписи.
- Проблемы, найденные в ревью (удалённый образ minio, ModuleNotFoundError без PYTHONPATH, докачка dev-акетов при старте, uv :latest), исправлены — см. коммиты выше.
- Повторная проверка БЕЗ override вскрыла падение сборки: `COPY scripts ./scripts` — каталог `scripts/` отсутствовал в репо (seed планировался на этап 5). Исправлено заглушкой `scripts/seed.py` (`0e398bc`: честный отказ с exit=1, без имитации успеха) + статический страж COPY/ADD-источников (`64b91f8`: каждый источник должен существовать и быть git-tracked; негативно проверен — падал до исправления). Попутно исправлена опечатка `set .env` → `set in .env` в seed-сервисе compose.

## НЕ проверено вручную (нужно после этих правок)

- Полный стек БЕЗ локального override-файла (команды — в резюме сессии): build с нуля, health, миграции при старте web, worker-stub, раздача `/videos/test` → 403.
- `docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed` — заглушка честно падает «seed not implemented yet» (exit=1); реальный seed — этап 5.
- deploy.sh на чистой Ubuntu — этап 5.

## Дальше

- Этап 2 (вертикальный срез, `docs/plan.md` 2.1–2.15): users+sessions, регистрация, логин/логаут, videos+video_views, storage-интерфейс, POST /api/videos, воркер transcode, страница просмотра, дедуп просмотров, реакции, комментарии, лента.

# Статус проекта

Обновлено: 2026-11-12 (после Этапа 2, части A–D).

## Сделано

- Этап 0: проектирование (requirements, architecture, db-schema, security,
  ADR-001..006, testing, plan) — принято ревьюером.
- Этап 1: каркас (uv, FastAPI /health + /docs, Settings, alembic, Dockerfile,
  compose, статические стражи) — принят ревьюером, ручная проверка Docker
  пройдена без override-файла.
- Этап 2, часть A (tag stage2-part-a, eeab8de): модели users/sessions +
  миграция a1b2c3d4e5f6, bcrypt (cost 12) без passlib, регистрация/вход/
  выход, сессии HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie, get_current_user,
  require_role, rate limit на вход (5/10 мин, in-memory в дев-режиме,
  Redis в production), тесты безопасности (дубликаты, generic 401,
  блокировка, 429, роль 403).
- Этап 2, часть B (tag stage2-part-b, 9bd1673): storage-интерфейс S3
  (put/presigned/delete), валидация загрузки (расширение + magic bytes +
  размер из env), POST /api/videos (multipart), raw-ключи, очередь
  arq-заглушка enqueue_transcode.
- Этап 2, часть C (tag stage2-part-c, 3468f7c): сервис транскода (ffmpeg
  480p + превью, синхронный, изолированный runner), access-контроль
  (can_view, can_view_with_acl, view_or_none), presigned GET c TTL из env.
- Этап 2, часть D (tag stage2-part-d, 00fcf83): модели video_views/
  reactions/comments/video_acl + миграция b7c8d9e0f1a2, SqlFeedRepo/
  SqlViewRepo/SqlReactionRepo/SqlCommentRepo/SqlAclRepo, эндпоинты:
  карточка GET /api/videos/{id}, лента GET /api/feed, поиск
  GET /api/search?q=, просмотры POST /api/videos/{id}/view (дедуп 24 ч,
  гости по cookie guest_id), реакции POST .../reactions, комментарии
  POST/GET .../comments (1 уровень, trim, 1..2000).
- Итог: 95 тестов зелёные (uv run pytest), ruff чист.

- Шаблоны и фронтенд (по заданию владельца — позже).
- Сервисы каналов/подписок/плейлистов/жалоб/модерации (этапы 3–4 плана).

- seed и deploy.sh (этап 5).

- Инциденты порчи вывода при записи больших файлов (ранее) — правило
  перечитывания соблюдено в этом этапе; в конце этапа замечен одиночный
  артефакт генерации в собственном сообщении агента (битая строка даты),
  содержимого файлов не касался, юнит-тестов/файлов не поразил.

  пишутся вручную и накрываются тестами-стражами (структурные маркеры).

  docs/requirements.md.

## Дальше

- Этап 3 (каналы, подписки, приватность UI, плейлисты, удаление) —
  после подтверждения владельцем результатов этапа 2.
